title: Austin-Healey: the sporting side of Austin
author: Les Caramagnols
excerpt: Born from the agreement between Austin and Donald Healey, Austin-Healey gave the Austin name a roadster and competition image.
content:
Austin-Healey has a separate place in Austin history. The name does not describe a simple sporting version of an existing saloon. It came from an agreement between Austin and Donald Healey in the early 1950s, with the aim of producing a more ambitious British roadster with strong export appeal.

That link gave Austin a different image. Alongside small popular cars and family saloons, Austin-Healey placed the badge in the world of sports cars, rallies, large roadsters and highly desirable classics.
